content.subject: Proposed changes to the agreement
content.body:
Hello,

I have reviewed the agreement and propose a few changes to ensure clarity. These modifications relate to the relevant clause:
- The agreement currently requires accepting scope changes within the overall project budget without additional payment. The proposed change is that any changes exceeding the budget must be documented in a written change request and priced separately.
- The relevant clause obligates providing up to 15 rounds of revisions for free, exceeding the allowed limit of 3 rounds. The proposed change is that the agreement should allow up to 3 rounds of ordinary revisions, with additional revisions requiring a written change order and corresponding fee.
- Payment is currently due 60 days after invoicing, which is longer than the standard 30-day term. The proposed change is that invoices are payable Net 30.
- The payment period requires waiting 60 days after invoicing to receive payment. The proposed change is that payment shall be made within 30 days of the invoice date.
- The relevant clause allows for up to 15 rounds of revisions, exceeding the allowed limit of 3 rounds. The proposed change is that the revision allowance shall be limited to 3 rounds.

Best regards
